sentences.text: A light stands one hundred feet above the water, and your eye is sixteen feet up on a flybridge.
The square root of one hundred is ten, and ten times one point one seven gives about eleven point seven miles.
The square root of sixteen is four, and four times one point one seven gives about four point seven miles.
The geographic range is the sum, about sixteen point four miles.
But if tonight’s visibility limits the luminous range to twelve miles, you’ll only see the light at about twelve miles.
